messages:
Eli: thanks for coming to the all-hands, leaving an open thread for anything we didn't cover earlier. post quick questions here.
Maya: framing: our north star remains predictable inference — latency, cost, and rollouts that behave the same everywhere.
Rina: short one: are we changing our positioning vs hyperscalers? need language for sales decks.
Jordan: not a head-on fight. position: we complement them when customers need control/consistency. call out scenarios (private, strict SLAs, cost-sensitive at scale).
Cole: roadmap nit: when is the Dedicated SLA work landing? customers are asking for dates.
Maya: targeted Q4 for initial 99.9% SLA and automated failover docs. detailed dates will be in the product weekly.
Sam: product marketing ask: what single metric should we lead with externally? latency SLO? cost savings?
Eli: lead with use-case numbers: "X% lower per-token cost for caching-heavy workloads" and a latency SLO promise. engineers like numbers, execs want dollars.
Rina: competitor question: how do we handle customers who prefer cloud-managed models?
Jordan: we integrate where helpful (marketplace), but we differentiate on operational guarantees and observability that clouds don't prioritize.
AllHandsBot: poll "Which should we publish first?" options: 1) SLA announcement 2) Benchmark report 3) Private onboarding checklist. React 1/2/3.
Maya: action items: PMs will draft the SLA page, marketing + eng will scope a benchmark repo, and solutions will draft the onboarding checklist.
Eli: great thread — we'll collect follow-ups and publish an FAQ + short slide deck by EOW. keep the short questions coming.
